aggregation: per layer the slowest of the item's three ratio calls, summed over layers
fresh_process: per shard: Phase A and Phase B are separate processes on the same GPU
inputs: fresh copies of the per-item tensors for every timed select call, after one untimed select pass per ratio on random tensors with the item's shapes; fresh policy instance per item and ratio
latency_reference: trusted plain prefill of the same context re-measured in Phase B on the same device
warmup: one untimed fully gated select pass over all layers per ratio on a 2048-token random decoy
